description: This file provides demo seed services for user-specific data in a financial dashboard application, including functions to fetch, seed, and generate demo transactions and alerts, as well as mapping database rows to UI-friendly formats.

methods.name: seedFromUserId
methods.description: Generates a seed value based on user ID for demo data variation.

methods.name: toDateOnly
methods.description: Converts ISO date-time string to YYYY-MM-DD format.

methods.name: fetchTransactions
methods.description: Fetches user transactions from Supabase database.

methods.name: fetchAlerts
methods.description: Fetches user alerts from Supabase database.

methods.name: buildDemoAlerts
methods.description: Creates a set of predefined demo alert objects.

methods.name: seedDemoDataIfEmpty
methods.description: Seeds demo transactions and alerts if the user's tables are empty.

methods.name: generateSampleData
methods.description: Generates and inserts sample transaction and alert data for a user.

methods.name: mapTxRowToUi
methods.description: Maps database transaction row to UI format.

methods.name: mapAlertRowToUi
methods.description: Maps database alert row to UI format.

methods.name: fetchTransactionsForUi
methods.description: Fetches and maps user transactions for UI components.

methods.name: fetchAlertsForUi
methods.description: Fetches and maps user alerts for UI components.
